title: Screen 2: Wave — non-blocking review follow-ups
description: Non-blocking findings from pr-reviewer's review of PR #21 (screen2-wave), tracked here per CLAUDE.md's autonomous-pipeline rule so they aren't lost once that PR merges. None are blocking; pick up if this area is touched again or as standalone cleanup.

checklist.step: _is_force_index_spike's `negative: bool` parameter forces double-negative reasoning (`if negative and latest >= 0`, `if not negative and latest <= 0`); both branches are correct and tested, but a signed-multiplier form would read more directly for a future editor.

Fix the self-contradictory docstring on evaluate_wave's new len-guard: it says it mirrors evaluate_impulse's `len(daily_ohlcv) < 2` guard 'in this same module (app/signals/impulse.py)', but evaluate_wave lives in triple_screen.py, a different module, and the condition actually implemented is `== 0`, not `< 2`.

Add a regression test pinning the 1-row daily_ohlcv boundary case — only 0 rows is currently covered (test_empty_daily_ohlcv_degrades_to_no_wave_instead_of_raising); the 0-row-vs-<2 guard asymmetry vs. evaluate_impulse means a future stricter single-row check elsewhere wouldn't be caught here.
